verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance SaaS platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only an MCP server, an llms.txt help-center index and an AI helpbot. Nothing shows a public API reference, let alone one that is interactive with runnable examples. The MCP server and llms.txt are adjacent agent-access features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
